stable_function_closure: ghidra::Address::justifiedContain(int4, const Address &, int4, bool) const address.cc:131
status_detail: The three-case covered projection byte-matches Ghidra 12.0.4's Address::justifiedContain one-sided-violation polarity and branch arithmetic (LE/BE x forceleft over 17 geometries including 1/4/8/cross-4 size boundaries), the ParamEntry alignment==0 wrapper, and the characterizeAsParam three-way classification. Re-pinned after FSPEC-JUSTIFIED-ENDIAN-0002 threaded the space endianness through justified_contain_range: view=start rows now exercise force_left=false on a little-endian space (the defect route), and the be=1 rows pin the BE arithmetic through the helper because the transitional enum AddressSpace cannot stage a BE ParamEntry. Overall remains UNTESTED because the space-mismatch base check and resolver-gated foreign-start characterize queries are not exercised by this fixture (both are covered by the successor fixture fspec_endian_resolver_1204).

comparand.rust_crate_tree_hash_scheme: sha256 of rugra-justified-contain-base-overlay-v1 plus base commit and sorted length-prefixed paths and contents

architecture.spaces: const=0, other=1, unique=2, ram=3 (little-endian), ram_be=4 (big-endian); byte addressed, wordsize 1
architecture.space_construction: FixtureTranslate/AddrSpace inserts ConstantSpace, OtherSpace, UniqueSpace and two IPTR_PROCESSOR AddrSpaces (ram LE index 3, ram_be BE index 4) with AddrSpace::hasphysical; the LE/BE pair is the decisive endianness control for Address::justifiedContain branch selection

compiler_spec.prototype_xml: no cspec decode; staged ParamEntry resources (case2: LE force-left exclusion 8B min1 and BE unflagged exclusion 8B min1; case3: single LE force-left exclusion 4B min1 in a ParamListStandard)
compiler_spec.calling_convention: hand-built ParamEntry/ParamListStandard via the staged loader (C++ direct field writes under the class->struct access hack, Rust pub builder setters); populateResolver/finalize_after_decode complete the case-3 model

analysis_options.api: Direct production Address::justifiedContain, ParamEntry::justifiedContain (alignment==0 path) and ParamListStandard::characterizeAsParam calls on both sides; no Action, Rule, PrintC or Funcdata pipeline
analysis_options.model_state: case1: raw Address pairs in ram/ram_be over 17 (base, esz, qoff, qsz) geometries; case2: two standalone 8-byte exclusion entries at 0x100 (LE force_left_justify, BE unflagged); case3: ParamListStandard with one 4-byte exclusion force-left entry at 0x100 minsize 1, numgroup 1
analysis_options.normalization: None. Raw int4 offsets and classification codes (no_containment=0, contains_unjustified=1, contains_justified=2, contained_by=3) are printed verbatim; the C++ side additionally exits non-zero if LE(false) != LE(true) != BE(true) branch consistency fails
analysis_options.random_seed: none; construction and queries are deterministic
analysis_options.error_injection: none; all queries stay on valid inputs

input_manifest.canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps({architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options, cases}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False)

cases.setup: 17 fixed geometries over entries 8B@0x1000, 4B@0x2000, 1B@0x3000; per geometry two rows
cases.queries: exact and sub-range size boundaries (1, 4, 8, cross-4); one-sided violations: equal-start-bigger (0x1000/12), low overlap flush at entry end (0xFFE/10), strict superset (0xFFC/16), high poke (0x1004/8), low overlap ending inside (0xFFE/6), cross-4 superset/high-poke over the 4-byte entry, size-1 entry equal-start-bigger and superset
cases.expect: every one-sided violation returns -1 on both branch views (address.cc:133/137 are independent checks); sub-ranges return the branch arithmetic (view=start: op2.offset-offset, view=end: off1-off2)

cases.setup: ParamEntry::justifiedContain alignment==0 path over an LE force-left exclusion entry and a BE unflagged exclusion entry (both 8B@0x100, minsize 1)
cases.queries: LE: exact, justified/unjustified sub-ranges, flush sub-range, size-1 sub-range, equal-start-bigger, low overlap inside, superset, high poke, fully above, fully below; BE: exact, low sub-range, flush sub-range, size-1, equal-start-bigger, low overlap flush at entry end
cases.expect: the wrapper forwards to Address::justifiedContain with forceleft=(flags & force_left_justify): LE-flagged and BE-unflagged entries pin both branch arithmetics through the real entry path; all one-sided violations stay -1

cases.setup: ParamListStandard with one LE 4-byte exclusion force-left entry at 0x100 (minsize 1, numgroup 1), populateResolver/finalize_after_decode
cases.queries: query starts kept inside the entry extent (resolver find(loc) gating): exact (0x100/4), size-1 justified (0x100/1), unjustified sub-ranges (0x102/2, 0x103/1), equal-start pokes (0x100/6, 0x100/8), high pokes (0x102/4, 0x101/4)
cases.expect: three-way classification chain (fspec.cc:697-714): off==0 -> contains_justified(2), off>0 -> contains_unjustified(1), off<0 + exclusion containedBy -> contained_by(3), else no_containment(0); the equal-start pokes exercise the FSPEC-JUSTIFIED-CONTAIN-0001 fix (off=-1 -> contained_by, previously misclassified contains_justified)

observation_schema.format: 63 fixed-order UTF-8 lines with final newline: one envelope, three case headers, then 34 jc rows (17 geometries x view=start/end), 17 pe rows (11 LE-flagged + 6 BE-unflagged) and 8 ch rows
observation_schema.polarity: jc/pe off values expose the independent one-sided -1 checks (address.cc:133/137) versus the branch arithmetic for contained ranges
observation_schema.branches: jc/pe off values expose the independent one-sided -1 checks (address.cc:133/137) versus the branch arithmetic for contained ranges; view=start pins the op2.offset - offset arithmetic (Ghidra LE forceleft=false/true and BE forceleft=true; Rust force_left=false with a little-endian space — re-pinned by FSPEC-JUSTIFIED-ENDIAN-0002); view=end pins off1 - off2 (Ghidra BE forceleft=false; Rust force_left=false with a big-endian space); the be=1 pe rows pin the same BE arithmetic via the helper (the enum-space model cannot stage a BE ParamEntry); the C++ harness additionally verifies LE(false)==LE(true)==BE(true) internally and exits non-zero on violation
observation_schema.classification: ch rows print the numeric characterizeAsParam code (no_containment=0, contains_unjustified=1, contains_justified=2, contained_by=3); equal-start pokes demonstrate the FSPEC-JUSTIFIED-CONTAIN-0001 fix (off=-1 -> contained_by)

decisive_semantics.references_and_outputs: Address::justifiedContain returns int4 by value (-1 or the endian-aware offset); ParamEntry::justifiedContain forwards to it with forceleft=(flags & force_left_justify) on the alignment==0 path; characterizeAsParam consumes the sign (==0 justified, >0 unjustified) and falls to the exclusion containedBy check before no_containment
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: characterizeAsParam walks the per-space resolver ranges containing loc.getOffset() (resolverMap[space->getIndex()], populateResolver fspec.cc:1191-1216), then exclusion entries starting inside the query range only if the first find() is non-end; fixture queries keep loc inside the entry extent so both loops observe the single entry
decisive_semantics.counters_and_accumulators: none; all three functions are pure queries over immutable model state
decisive_semantics.sort_and_comparison_keys: containment decision keys are the raw offset comparisons op2.offset < offset and off2 > off1 (uintb, independent), plus containedBy's addressbase < addr and entryoff <= rangeoff; classification tie order is justified (off==0) before unjustified (off>0) before contained_by before no_containment per the fspec.cc:697-714 return ladder
